answer.label: fine-tune backdoor
answer.justification: Every activation feature matches the fine-tune backdoor fingerprint. Onset is at layer 3, which is the early-bump signature. Relative L2 is flat through the middle (0.163 at layer 8, 0.155 at layer 16) and reaches 0.283 at layer 32, against the reference 0.17/0.17/0.30. The final-layer jump is small (+0.037), and the mid-layer size ratio is 1.016, above 1. Rank is 3.63 (reference 3.53), direction consistency 0.627 (reference 0.62), cosine 0.957 (reference 0.952), and the layer-2 spike is small (0.2). Quantization is ruled out by the size ratio above 1, the lower rank and the higher consistency. Fine-tune bias is ruled out by consistency of 0.63 rather than 0.70, the early onset, and the small final jump and final value. The system-prompt classes are ruled out by the absence of a layer-2 spike and of a 0.4 mid-depth plateau. Only activation-level data was available, so the text and logit checks could not be used.
